discordrpc.config.title: Discord Rich Presence
discordrpc.preview.hint: Click any part of the card to edit it.
discordrpc.zone.name: Activity Name
discordrpc.editor.name: Activity name
discordrpc.editor.name.hint: Shown on Discord instead of "Minecraft", on the card and in "Playing ..." under your name. Use 2 letters or more. Leave it empty to keep Minecraft.
discordrpc.editor.image_key.hint: Pick below, upload, or paste a link
discordrpc.editor.image_key.tooltip: A built-in image name, or a link to any image online (https://...). In a link, {uuid} becomes your account, so it always shows your own skin.
discordrpc.editor.timestamp.hint: Elapsed counts up from when you started playing. Local Time shows a clock instead.
discordrpc.editor.button.hint: Discord never shows you your own buttons. Other people can see and click them.
discordrpc.section.pick_screen: Which screen should this override apply to?
discordrpc.section.pick_dimension: Which dimension should this override apply to?
discordrpc.server.name: Server name
discordrpc.server.ip_filter.hint: This profile activates when the server address contains this text.
discordrpc.override.edit.tooltip: Fields you don't change are inherited from the profile above.
discordrpc.override.explain: Each field either inherits from "%s" or replaces it. Click a field to edit it.
discordrpc.override.done.tooltip: Keep this override and go back
discordrpc.override.clear.tooltip: Reset every field to inherit again
discordrpc.settings.discord_account.none: No Discord app is open on this PC right now. Open one and it shows up here.
discordrpc.status.reset_confirm: This wipes all profiles - click again to confirm
discordrpc.conflict.title: %s is overriding your presence
discordrpc.conflict.body: %1$s has its own Discord status that hides this mod's. In the %1$s settings, turn off "Discord RPC", quit the app completely (check the tray), reopen it, then start the game again.
discordrpc.conflict.chat: [DiscordPresence] The %s's built-in Discord status is hiding your custom presence. Press F6 and open Settings for the fix.
discordrpc.button.reset_to_inherit.toolt: Drop this override and use the profile's value again
discordrpc.button.restore_defaults.toolt: Replace this tab's profile with the built-in default
discordrpc.button.export_profiles.toolti: Save profiles as JSON files you can share
discordrpc.button.open_profiles_folder.t: Drop .json profile files here to import or back them up
discordrpc.button.reset_everything.toolt: Reset all settings and profiles to how the mod shipped
discordrpc.button.upload_image.tooltip: Pick a PNG, JPG or GIF from your computer. It goes up on %s so Discord can show it, and a copy is kept in config/discordrpc/images. You can also drag an image onto this window.
discordrpc.export.title: Export Profiles
discordrpc.export.hint: Click a profile to save it as a JSON file.
discordrpc.import.title: Import Profiles
discordrpc.import.hint: Click a file to add it as a new profile.
discordrpc.import.empty.hint: Export a profile first, or drop .json files into config/discordrpc/profiles/.
discordrpc.images.skin.head: 3D Head
discordrpc.images.skin.name: Your %s
discordrpc.images.skin.tooltip: %s from your own skin. It changes when your skin does.
discordrpc.upload.tip: Drop an image on this window to upload it
discordrpc.upload.warn_local: Not uploaded, so Discord can't show it
discordrpc.upload.warn_unknown: Discord won't know this image name
discordrpc.upload.done: Uploaded "%s". It shows on Discord with the next update.
discordrpc.upload.busy: Wait for the current upload to finish
discordrpc.upload.drop_on_presence_tab: Open a presence tab, then drop the image again
discordrpc.upload.consent.title: Upload "%s"?
discordrpc.upload.consent.body: Discord can only show images that are online, so this puts it on %s, a free image host. Anyone with the link can see it, and it stays up even if you remove it here. You'll only be asked this once.
discordrpc.upload.error.type: Use a PNG, JPG or GIF image
discordrpc.upload.error.size: That image is too big (%s MB max)
discordrpc.upload.error.network: Couldn't reach %s. Check your connection and try again.
discordrpc.upload.error.unknown: The upload failed. The game log has the details.
discordrpc.upload.error.link: That doesn't look like a link
